title: Assistive Partner Responds to Reviews and Questions - Functional Test Plan
overview: Comprehensive functional testing of the AP Responds to Reviews and Questions feature on the Y4J AT/AD Vendor Portal. Covers AP interaction panel access (Reviews & Ratings and Queries sections), responding to approved reviews (text-based, 500 char limit, pending moderation), responding to user questions (routed through admin moderation), admin moderation workflow (approve/reject/edit), response visibility on PwD portal (labeled, timestamped, visually distinct), notification and tracking (new reviews, approval/rejection alerts), editing and withdrawing responses (re-moderation on edit, confirmation on delete), content guidelines enforcement, privacy and security (anonymized AP responses, no direct messaging), error handling, and audit trail logging.

inScope: AP Interaction Panel: Reviews & Ratings and Queries sections on dashboard
Review/question entry display: Product Name, Star Rating, Text, Date, Anonymous Tag, Status
Responding to approved reviews: text response up to 500 chars, Respond to Review button
Pending Moderation label and status after response submission
Responding to questions: question text, timestamp, context, AP response
Admin moderation workflow: Approve, Reject (with feedback), Edit (optional)
Response visibility on PwD portal: labeled 'Response from Assistive Partner', timestamped, visually distinct
Notifications: new reviews/questions, admin approval/rejection of responses
Editing pending or approved responses (re-enters moderation queue)
Content guidelines: no promotional content, no personal contact, neutral language
Privacy: AP responses show organization name only, PwD details hidden
Error handling: save failure message, pending status with timestamp
Audit trail: all responses, edits, moderation actions logged
outOfScope: Admin moderation UI internals and GenAI flagging
PwD Queries detail flow (covered in SCRUM-201)

testCases.title: Verify AP dashboard includes Reviews & Ratings and Queries sections
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as an approved Assistive Partner with listed products
steps: 1. Log in as an approved Assistive Partner
2. Navigate to the AP dashboard
3. Verify 'Reviews & Ratings' section is visible and accessible
4. Verify 'Queries' section is visible and accessible
5. Click on 'Reviews & Ratings' section
6. Verify the section loads without errors
expectedResults: Both 'Reviews & Ratings' and 'Queries' sections are visible on the dashboard
Sections are clickable and load without errors
Navigation between sections works correctly
testCases.postconditions: User is on the Reviews & Ratings section

testCases.title: Verify response text is limited to 500 characters
testCases.preconditions: AP is responding to an approved review
steps: 1. Click 'Respond to Review' on an approved review
2. Enter exactly 500 characters of text
3. Verify the text is accepted
4. Attempt to enter 501 characters
5. Verify the input is restricted or a validation message appears
6. Verify a character counter is displayed showing remaining characters
expectedResults: 500 characters are accepted without error
Text beyond 500 characters is prevented or flagged
Character counter shows current/remaining count
Validation message is clear if limit is exceeded
testCases.postconditions: Character limit is enforced

testCases.title: Verify AP cannot respond to Pending or Flagged reviews
testCases.preconditions: AP has reviews in Pending Moderation and Flagged statuses
steps: 1. Navigate to Reviews & Ratings section
2. Locate a review with 'Pending Moderation' status
3. Verify 'Respond to Review' button is NOT available
4. Locate a review with 'Flagged' status
5. Verify 'Respond to Review' button is NOT available
6. Locate an 'Approved' review
7. Verify 'Respond to Review' button IS available
expectedResults: Respond button is hidden/disabled for Pending Moderation reviews
Respond button is hidden/disabled for Flagged reviews
Respond button is only available for Approved reviews
testCases.postconditions: Response capability is restricted to approved reviews only

testCases.title: Verify AP cannot submit an empty response
testCases.preconditions: AP is responding to an approved review
steps: 1. Click 'Respond to Review' on an approved review
2. Leave the response text field empty
3. Attempt to submit the response
4. Verify a validation error is displayed
5. Enter whitespace-only text
6. Attempt to submit
7. Verify a validation error is displayed
expectedResults: Empty response cannot be submitted
Whitespace-only response cannot be submitted
Clear validation message is shown (e.g., 'Response cannot be empty')
testCases.postconditions: Empty responses are prevented

testCases.title: Verify AP can respond to user questions with context displayed
testCases.preconditions: AP has products with user-submitted questions in the Queries section
steps: 1. Navigate to Queries section
2. Locate a user question
3. Verify the question displays:
a. Question text
b. Timestamp
c. Context (e.g., 'Asked about Product Availability')
4. Click the respond button
5. Enter a response explaining relevant product details
6. Submit the response
7. Verify the response enters 'Pending Moderation' status
expectedResults: Question displays text, timestamp, and context
AP can enter and submit a response
Response is routed through admin moderation
Response status shows 'Pending Moderation'
testCases.postconditions: AP response to question is submitted for moderation

testCases.title: Verify admin can Approve an AP response making it publicly visible
testCases.preconditions: AP has submitted a response that is in Pending Moderation status
steps: 1. Log in as admin
2. Navigate to the moderation queue
3. Locate the AP's pending response
4. Review the response for accuracy, tone, and compliance
5. Click 'Approve'
6. Verify the response status changes to 'Approved/Published'
7. Log in as a PwD user
8. Navigate to the product details page
9. Verify the AP response is now visible beneath the corresponding review/question
expectedResults: Admin can view pending AP responses in moderation queue
Approving changes status to Published
Approved response becomes visible on the PwD-facing product page
Response is displayed with correct content
testCases.postconditions: AP response is publicly visible after admin approval

testCases.title: Verify admin can Reject an AP response with feedback reason
testCases.preconditions: AP has submitted a response in Pending Moderation status
steps: 1. Log in as admin
2. Navigate to the moderation queue
3. Locate the AP's pending response
4. Click 'Reject'
5. Enter a feedback reason for rejection
6. Submit the rejection
7. Verify the response status changes to 'Rejected'
8. Log in as the AP
9. Verify the AP receives a notification with the rejection reason
expectedResults: Admin can reject an AP response with a reason
Response status changes to Rejected
AP receives notification with feedback reason
Rejected response is NOT visible on the PwD portal
testCases.postconditions: AP is notified of rejection with reason; response is not published

testCases.title: Verify admin can Edit an AP response before approval
testCases.preconditions: AP has submitted a response in Pending Moderation status
steps: 1. Log in as admin
2. Navigate to the moderation queue
3. Locate the AP's pending response
4. Click 'Edit'
5. Make minor formatting or content fixes
6. Save the edits
7. Approve the edited response
8. Verify the edited version is published on the PwD portal
expectedResults: Admin can edit AP response content before approval
Edits are saved successfully
Edited and approved response is published with correct content
Edit action is logged in audit trail
testCases.postconditions: Edited response is published

testCases.title: Verify approved response displays correctly on PwD portal
testCases.preconditions: An AP response has been approved by admin
steps: 1. Log in as a PwD user (or view product page as public)
2. Navigate to the product details page
3. Scroll to the review/question that has an AP response
4. Verify the response is displayed beneath the corresponding review/question
5. Verify the label reads: 'Response from Assistive Partner'
6. Verify the response includes a timestamp
7. Verify the response includes the AP organization name
8. Verify the response is visually distinguished (shaded background, indentation)
expectedResults: AP response appears beneath the corresponding review/question
Label 'Response from Assistive Partner' is displayed
Timestamp is shown on the response
AP organization name is displayed (not individual user name)
Response is visually distinct from user posts (shaded/indented)
testCases.postconditions: AP response is correctly displayed on PwD portal

testCases.title: Verify AP receives notification for new reviews
testCases.preconditions: AP is logged in; a PwD submits a new review for AP's product
steps: 1. Have a PwD submit a new review for an AP's product
2. Log in as the AP
3. Verify a notification appears on the dashboard for the new review
4. Verify the notification includes the product name
5. Click the notification
6. Verify navigation to the relevant review
expectedResults: Notification appears for new review submission
Notification includes product name
Clicking notification navigates to the review
testCases.postconditions: AP is aware of the new review

testCases.title: Verify AP receives notification for new questions
testCases.preconditions: AP is logged in; a PwD submits a new question for AP's product
steps: 1. Have a PwD submit a new question for an AP's product
2. Log in as the AP
3. Verify a notification appears on the dashboard for the new question
4. Verify the notification includes the product name and context
5. Click the notification
6. Verify navigation to the relevant question in Queries section
expectedResults: Notification appears for new question submission
Notification includes product name
Clicking notification navigates to the question
testCases.postconditions: AP is aware of the new question

testCases.title: Verify AP receives notification when response is approved by admin
testCases.preconditions: AP has submitted a response; admin approves it
steps: 1. Submit a response as AP
2. Have admin approve the response
3. Log in as the AP
4. Verify a notification appears (e.g., 'Your response to Smart Hearing Aid X has been approved and published.')
5. Verify the notification appears in the dashboard
6. Verify optional email notification is sent (if configured)
expectedResults: Approval notification appears on AP dashboard
Notification text includes product name and approval status
Email notification is sent if configured
testCases.postconditions: AP is informed of response approval

testCases.title: Verify AP receives notification when response is rejected by admin
testCases.preconditions: AP has submitted a response; admin rejects it with feedback
steps: 1. Submit a response as AP
2. Have admin reject the response with a feedback reason
3. Log in as the AP
4. Verify a rejection notification appears on the dashboard
5. Verify the notification includes the feedback reason
6. Verify the AP can view the rejected response and reason
expectedResults: Rejection notification appears on AP dashboard
Notification includes the admin's feedback reason
AP can review the rejection details
testCases.postconditions: AP is informed of rejection with actionable feedback

testCases.title: Verify AP can edit a pending response (re-enters moderation queue)
testCases.preconditions: AP has a response in Pending Moderation status
steps: 1. Navigate to the response in Pending Moderation status
2. Click 'Edit' on the pending response
3. Modify the response text
4. Save the edited response
5. Verify the response re-enters the admin moderation queue
6. Verify the status remains 'Pending Moderation'
expectedResults: Edit option is available on pending responses
AP can modify the response text
Edited response re-enters the moderation queue
Status shows Pending Moderation after edit
testCases.postconditions: Edited response is queued for re-moderation

testCases.title: Verify AP can edit an approved response (re-enters moderation queue)
testCases.preconditions: AP has a response that was previously approved and published
steps: 1. Navigate to the approved/published response
2. Click 'Edit' on the approved response
3. Modify the response text
4. Save the edited response
5. Verify the response re-enters the admin moderation queue
6. Verify the previous published version is removed or replaced with 'Under Review'
7. Verify the edited response requires admin re-approval before republishing
expectedResults: Edit option is available on approved responses
Edited response re-enters moderation queue
Previously published version is handled appropriately
Re-approval is required before the edited version is published
testCases.postconditions: Edited response awaits re-moderation

testCases.title: Verify AP can withdraw/delete a response with confirmation prompt
testCases.preconditions: AP has a pending or approved response
steps: 1. Navigate to a response (pending or approved)
2. Click 'Withdraw' or 'Delete' option
3. Verify a confirmation prompt appears (e.g., 'Are you sure you want to withdraw this response?')
4. Click 'Cancel' on the confirmation
5. Verify the response is NOT deleted
6. Click 'Withdraw' again
7. Click 'Confirm' on the confirmation prompt
8. Verify the response is removed
9. Verify the response is no longer visible on the PwD portal (if it was published)
expectedResults: Withdraw/Delete option is available
Confirmation prompt appears before deletion
Canceling preserves the response
Confirming removes the response
Withdrawn response is removed from public view
testCases.postconditions: Response is withdrawn and no longer visible

testCases.title: Verify content guidelines are enforced (no promotional content, no personal contact)
testCases.preconditions: AP is responding to a review
steps: 1. Click 'Respond to Review' on an approved review
2. Enter response with promotional content (e.g., 'Buy now at 50% off!')
3. Submit the response
4. Verify the response is flagged or rejected during moderation
5. Enter response with personal contact info (e.g., 'Call me at 9876543210')
6. Submit the response
7. Verify the response is flagged or rejected during moderation
8. Enter a neutral, factual response with a product manual link
9. Submit the response
10. Verify the response passes moderation
expectedResults: Promotional content is flagged/rejected during moderation
Personal contact information is flagged/rejected during moderation
Neutral, factual responses with relevant links are accepted
Content guidelines are enforced through the moderation workflow
testCases.postconditions: Content guidelines are enforced

testCases.title: Verify AP responses show organization name only (not individual user details)
testCases.preconditions: An AP response has been approved and published
steps: 1. Log in as a PwD user
2. Navigate to a product page with an AP response
3. Verify the response shows the AP organization name
4. Verify NO individual vendor user name is displayed
5. Verify NO individual vendor email or contact is displayed
6. Verify PwD user details remain hidden in the review/question
expectedResults: AP response displays organization name only
No individual vendor user details are exposed
PwD user details remain anonymous
Communication is entirely within the portal (no direct messaging)
testCases.postconditions: Privacy is maintained for both AP individuals and PwD users

testCases.title: Verify PwD personal details are never visible to AP in reviews or questions
testCases.preconditions: AP is viewing reviews and questions on the dashboard
steps: 1. Navigate to Reviews & Ratings section
2. Verify all reviews show anonymous user tags (e.g., 'PwD User 1021')
3. Verify NO real names, emails, phone numbers, or addresses are displayed
4. Navigate to Queries section
5. Verify all questions show anonymous user tags
6. Verify NO PII is visible in any question entry
7. Inspect network requests to confirm no PII is transmitted
expectedResults: All reviews use anonymous user identifiers
All questions use anonymous user identifiers
No PII is visible anywhere in the AP's view
No PII leakage in network responses
testCases.postconditions: PwD privacy is fully maintained

testCases.title: Verify no direct messaging capability exists between AP and PwD
testCases.preconditions: AP is viewing reviews and questions
steps: 1. Navigate to Reviews & Ratings section
2. Verify no 'Message User' or 'Contact Reviewer' option exists
3. Navigate to Queries section
4. Verify no direct messaging option exists
5. Verify all communication is through the respond/moderation workflow only
expectedResults: No direct messaging feature is available
All communication goes through admin-moderated responses
No way to contact PwD users directly
testCases.postconditions: Communication is restricted to moderated channels

testCases.title: Verify all responses, edits, and moderation actions are logged in audit trail
testCases.preconditions: AP has submitted, edited, and had responses approved/rejected
steps: 1. Submit a response as AP
2. Edit the response
3. Have admin approve the response
4. Verify audit trail logs contain:
a. Product ID
b. AP ID
c. Timestamp for each action
d. Action type: Submitted
e. Action type: Edited
f. Action type: Approved
5. Withdraw a different response
6. Verify 'Deleted' action is logged
7. Have admin reject another response
8. Verify 'Rejected' action is logged
expectedResults: All actions (Submitted, Edited, Approved, Rejected, Deleted) are logged
Each log entry includes Product ID, AP ID, and timestamp
Audit trail is complete and chronological
Admin can access the audit logs
testCases.postconditions: Complete audit trail exists for all response actions

testCases.title: Verify admin reports show response metrics (avg response time, approval rate)
testCases.preconditions: Multiple AP responses have been processed through moderation
steps: 1. Log in as admin
2. Navigate to reporting/analytics section
3. Verify metrics are available:
a. Average response time by vendor
b. Percentage of responses approved vs. rejected
4. Verify metrics are accurate based on actual data
5. Verify reports can be filtered by vendor or time period
expectedResults: Admin can view average response time per vendor
Admin can view approval vs. rejection percentage
Metrics are accurate and up-to-date
Reports are filterable
testCases.postconditions: Admin reporting is functional

testCases.title: Verify error message when response fails to save
testCases.preconditions: Simulate a save failure (network issue or API error)
steps: 1. Click 'Respond to Review' on an approved review
2. Enter response text
3. Simulate a network/API failure
4. Attempt to submit the response
5. Verify error message: 'Unable to save your response at this time. Please try again later.'
6. Verify the response text is preserved (not lost)
7. Restore connectivity
8. Retry submission
9. Verify successful submission after retry
expectedResults: Error message is displayed on save failure
Message text matches: 'Unable to save your response at this time. Please try again later.'
Response text is not lost on failure
Retry works after connectivity is restored
testCases.postconditions: Error handling provides clear guidance and preserves user input

testCases.title: Verify pending response shows visible timestamp when moderation is delayed
testCases.preconditions: AP has submitted a response that remains in Pending Moderation for an extended period
steps: 1. Submit a response as AP
2. Wait without admin moderation
3. Navigate to the response
4. Verify the response shows 'Pending Moderation' status
5. Verify a visible timestamp shows when the response was submitted
6. Verify the AP can see how long the response has been pending
expectedResults: Pending status is clearly displayed
Submission timestamp is visible
AP can track how long moderation has been pending
testCases.postconditions: Pending status with timestamp is displayed

testCases.title: Verify response text boxes and buttons are keyboard and screen-reader accessible
testCases.preconditions: AP is on the Reviews & Ratings section
steps: 1. Navigate to Reviews & Ratings using keyboard only (Tab, Enter)
2. Verify 'Respond to Review' button is keyboard focusable and activatable
3. Verify the response text box is keyboard accessible
4. Verify 'Edit' and 'Withdraw' buttons are keyboard accessible
5. Verify status labels ('Pending Admin Review') have clear text
6. Verify visual contrast between user reviews and vendor responses
7. Verify responses can be expanded/collapsed for readability
expectedResults: All interactive elements are keyboard navigable
Screen reader announces button labels and status correctly
Clear labels like 'Respond', 'Edit', 'Pending Admin Review' are present
Visual contrast between reviews and responses meets WCAG standards
Expand/collapse functionality works for long responses
testCases.postconditions: Accessibility compliance is confirmed
